definitions.explanation: The monetary amount of 1,000 Japanese yen. A common denomination in everyday transactions.

examples.japanese: {千円|せんえん}{札|さつ}で{払|はら}った。
examples.english: I paid with a 1,000 yen bill.

examples.japanese: ランチは{千円|せんえん}くらいだ。
{千円|せんえん}{以下|いか}で{買|か}えるものを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for something I can buy for under 1,000 yen.

notes:
{千円|せんえん} is one of the most commonly used monetary amounts in Japan.

CURRENCY:
- {千円|せんえん}{札|さつ}: 1,000 yen bill
- Features {北里|きたさと}{柴三郎|しばさぶろう} (bacteriologist) on current bills (2024-)
- Previously featured {野口|のぐち}{英世|ひでよ}

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {千円|せんえん}ちょうど: exactly 1,000 yen
- {千円|せんえん}{以内|いない}: within 1,000 yen
- {千円|せんえん}カット: 1,000 yen haircut (budget hair salon)
- {千円|せんえん}{均一|きんいつ}: all items 1,000 yen

RELATED AMOUNTS:
- {五千円|ごせんえん}: 5,000 yen
- {一万円|いちまんえん}: 10,000 yen
- {百円|ひゃくえん}: 100 yen
